blurb: Move With Grace Dance Studio offers a wide range of dance classes including ballet, jazz, tap, hip hop, contemporary/lyrical, acrobatics, and musical theatre. Classes are designed for all ages and skill levels, from toddlers to adults, with a focus on building confidence, creativity, and technical skills. The studio provides a supportive environment with opportunities for performance and competition.
